correctness.rationale: Explicit determinant equations yield a product of independent radical-row counts; expanding indicators gives the exact formula. For geometry, the generic weight locus is an irreducible vector bundle of dimension 2d+m. Uniformity permits perturbation of every noncentral commuting pair into its closure. With B a dual weight-relation matrix, K(U) has a generic kernel vector with all coordinates nonzero exactly on the lower side m<2d, and has a full-column-rank witness when m>=2d; this proves that the central E^2 is contained in the generic closure exactly on the lower side. These steps hold over algebraic closures in every characteristic. Standalone checker independently exhausts 19 small configurations, not infinite families.
